units.source_text: 走到清泷川岸边，有一座陡峭的山逼将过来。

en.t: When they reached the bank of the Kiyotaki River, a steep mountain seemed to press in toward them.

units.source_text: 不一会儿，就看见一片美丽无比的松林。

en.t: Before long, they saw a grove of pines of surpassing beauty.

units.source_text: 笔直参天的杉树非常整齐地耸立着，一看就知道是经过人工精心修整的。

en.t: Straight cedars reaching toward the sky stood in remarkably orderly rows, and one could tell at a glance that they had been carefully tended by human hands.

units.source_text: 只有这个村庄才出产这种有名的木材—北山圆木。

en.t: Only this village produces this famous timber, Kitayama round logs.
